items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And we were like the young alto players around there -- Bernie Peacock, Sonny Stitt, Rudy Rutherford.

ctx.x: Yeah, there were so many great players around Detroit during that time. They had an excellent pianist named Willie Anderson. He was terrific. And I also met Rudy Rutherford, who was a fine clarinetist, around that time. He was from Detroit. And we were like the young alto players around there -- Bernie Peacock, Sonny Stitt, Rudy Rutherford. And then Wardell came to town, Wardell Gray, when he came to town playing alto he was added to the list. So we had a lot of young saxophone players on the scene.
My gigs were picking up more and more, as I got better known around the city.
